response.text:
**Metric:** Net income margin (net income ÷ revenue) for Oracle Corporation, fiscal year 2023 (ended 2023-05-31).

**Calculation:**
- Net income (us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss, FY2023): $8,503M → $8,503,000,000
- Revenue (us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, FY2023): $49,954M → $49,954,000,000
- 8,503,000,000 ÷ 49,954,000,000 = 0.17022 → **17.02%**

**Evidence:** Both figures come from Oracle's FY2023 Form 10-K, accession 0000950170-23-028914 (CIK 1341439), filed 2023-06-20, period 2022-06-01 to 2023-05-31 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000095017023028914/0000950170-23-028914-index.htm. (Prior-year comparatives from the FY2022 10-K, accession 0001564590-22-023675, are supplied as context only and are not used in the FY2023 ratio.)

ANSWER: 17.02%
